instruction: Fix `to_csv` in `datastore/csvio.py` so it emits the header row. It currently ignores the `header` argument entirely, so callers that pass a header get data-only output.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore/csvio.py b/datastore/csvio.py
--- a/datastore/csvio.py
+++ b/datastore/csvio.py
@@ -34,5 +34,7 @@
     """
     buf = io.StringIO()
     writer = csv.writer(buf, lineterminator="\n")
+    if header is not None:
+        writer.writerow(header)
     writer.writerows(rows)
     return buf.getvalue()
